judul: Menjawab Wawancara: Metode STAR dan Gaji
title: Interview Answers: STAR and Salary
ringkas: Menceritakan pengalaman, menjawab pertanyaan sulit, gaji, dan menutup wawancara
goals: menjawab pertanyaan **gaji dan ketersediaan** dengan sopan

lesson.text: Pertanyaan perilaku seperti *Tell me about a time when ...* meminta contoh nyata. **Metode STAR** membantumu menjawab dengan runtut: **S**ituation, **T**ask, **A**ction, **R**esult. Unit ini juga melatih menjawab soal gaji dan menutup wawancara.

lesson.title: 1. Metode STAR
table: [[In my last job, a big client was unhappy with our service.]]
[[I had to solve the problem within two days.]]
[[I called the client, listened, and offered a new plan.]]
[[The client stayed with us and thanked the team.]]

examples.en: [[In my last job, a client was unhappy. I had to fix the problem. I called the client and offered a new plan. As a result, the client stayed with us.]]
examples.id: Di pekerjaan terakhirku, seorang klien tidak puas. Aku harus memperbaikinya. Aku menelepon klien dan menawarkan rencana baru. Hasilnya, klien tetap bersama kami.

lesson.title: 2. Gaji dan ketersediaan
table: [[Based on my experience and the market, I'm looking for ... Is that within your range?]]
[[I can start in two weeks, after my notice period.]]
[[Yes, when it's needed for the project.]]
[[I'm interviewing with a few companies, but this role is my first choice.]]

lesson.title: 3. Menutup wawancara dan email terima kasih
table: [[Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.]]
[[Dear Ms. Sari, Thank you for meeting with me today.]]
[[I enjoyed learning more about the role and the team.]]
[[I look forward to hearing from you. Best regards, Budi]]

lesson.title: Jangan menjelekkan perusahaan lama
lesson.text: Meskipun kamu keluar karena masalah, hindari mengkritik atasan lama. Fokus pada apa yang kamu cari: *I'm looking for new challenges and growth.*

lesson.title: Siapkan 3 cerita STAR
lesson.text: Siapkan tiga pengalaman nyata: satu tentang kerja sama, satu tentang masalah yang kamu selesaikan, satu tentang kegagalan yang kamu pelajari.

items: Gaji: sebut kisaran berdasarkan pengalaman dan pasar.
Tutup dengan Thank you for your time.

practice.q: Apa kepanjangan STAR?
options: Situation, Task, Action, Result
Skill, Time, Answer, Reason, Reply
Start, Talk, Ask, Reply, Review
Speak, Think, Act, Rest, Repeat
practice.exp: Metode STAR. Jawaban yang tepat: **Situation, Task, Action, Result**.

practice.q: Bagian "Situation" dalam STAR berisi...
options: konteks singkat
hasil akhir dari seluruh tindakanmu
tindakan yang kamu lakukan sendiri
gaji yang kamu harapkan dari perusahaan

practice.q: Bagian "Task" dalam STAR berisi...
options: tugas atau tanggung jawabmu
hasil dari semua tindakanmu di perusahaan
saran yang kamu berikan kepada perusahaan baru
pertanyaan yang kamu ajukan kepada pewawancara

practice.q: Bagian "Action" dalam STAR berisi...
options: yang kamu lakukan
hasil akhir dari seluruh pekerjaanmu
konteks tempat kerja yang lama
gaji yang kamu harapkan nanti

practice.q: Bagian "Result" dalam STAR berisi...
options: hasil dari tindakanmu
masalah yang kamu hadapi di tempat kerja lama
tugas yang diberikan atasanmu setiap hari
rencana kariermu untuk lima tahun ke depan

practice.q: Pilih kalimat Action yang baik:
options: I called the client, listened, and offered a new plan.
The client was very angry and shouted on the phone.
I was responsible for the project and its final report.
The client stayed with us, and the team was happy.
practice.exp: Tindakanmu. Jawaban yang tepat: **I called the client, listened, and offered a new plan.**

practice.q: Pilih kalimat Result yang baik:
options: As a result, the client stayed with us.
I called the client, listened, and offered a new plan.
There was a problem with the service at that time.
I had to solve it within the next two days.
practice.exp: Hasil. Jawaban yang tepat: **As a result, the client stayed with us.**

practice.q: Pilih kalimat Situation yang baik:
options: In my last job, a big client was unhappy.
I offered a new plan to the client and the whole team.
The client stayed with us for three more years afterwards.
I learned a lot about service from that experience.
practice.exp: Konteks. Jawaban yang tepat: **In my last job, a big client was unhappy.**

practice.q: Pilih jawaban untuk "What are your salary expectations?" yang paling profesional:
options: Based on my experience and the market, I am looking for a range of ... Is that within your budget?
As much as possible, because I think I deserve the best.
I do not care about the money, so you can decide it all.
Double my last salary, otherwise I will not join you.

practice.q: Pilih jawaban untuk "When can you start?":
options: I can start in two weeks, after my notice period.
I do not know when I can start, so please wait for me.
Tomorrow, because I already quit my job this morning.
Never, because I have not decided to join this company.

practice.q: Pilih jawaban untuk "Are you willing to work overtime?":
options: Yes, when it is needed for the project.
Never, because I do not work after the office hours.
I hate overtime, so please do not ask me about it.
Only on holidays, because I like to rest on weekdays.

practice.q: Pilih penutup wawancara yang baik:
options: Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.
Bye. I think the interview is finished now, right?
Call me later, because I need an answer quickly today.
Hurry up and decide, because I have other offers waiting.
practice.exp: Jawaban yang tepat: **Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.**

practice.q: Pilih subjek email terima kasih yang baik:
options: Thank you for the interview
Hi, I want to ask about the job and the salary again
Job application, please reply to me as soon as possible
Please reply fast because I need to know the answer now

practice.q: Pilih pembuka email terima kasih yang baik:
options: Dear Ms. Sari, thank you for meeting with me today.
Hey Sari! It was fun, and I think I did very well.
Hello? Did you get my resume, and have you read it?
I want the job, so please give me an answer today.

practice.q: Pilih penutup email terima kasih yang baik:
options: I look forward to hearing from you. Best regards, Budi
Reply to me now, because I am waiting for your answer. Budi
Bye bye for now, and please do not forget about me. Budi
Cheers! Call me quickly when you have decided. Budi
practice.exp: Jawaban yang tepat: **I look forward to hearing from you. Best regards, Budi**.

practice.q: Mengapa tidak boleh menjelekkan perusahaan lama?
options: terkesan tidak profesional
karena dilarang oleh hukum perusahaan
karena pewawancara bisa menjadi sangat marah
karena sebenarnya tidak ada alasan tertentu

practice.q: Jika ditanya soal tawaran lain, jawaban yang jujur dan aman:
options: I am interviewing with a few companies, but this role is my first choice.
No one wants me, so you are the only company that is left.
I have many better offers, but I will think about yours later.
I will take any offer, because I need money right now.

practice.q: Pilih ungkapan untuk menyebut hasil terukur:
options: As a result, sales increased by twenty percent.
Things went fine and everyone was happy in the team.
It was OK, and I think the client liked what we did.
Everyone was happy somehow, but I am not sure about it.

practice.q: As a ___, the client stayed with us.
practice.exp: As a result. Jawaban yang tepat: **result**.

practice.id: Aku bisa mulai dua minggu lagi.
practice.q: I can start in two ___.
Thank you for your ___.
I look forward to ___ from you.
Tell me about a time when you solved a difficult problem.
turns: Tell me about a time when you solved a difficult problem.
practice.id: Jawab dengan pola STAR secara singkat.
answers: In my last job, a client was unhappy. I called them, listened, and offered a new plan. As a result, they stayed with us.
Our system stopped working. I found the cause and fixed it in two hours, so the team could continue.
A project was late, so I made a new schedule and the team finished on time.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: In my last job, a client was unhappy. I called them, listened, and offered a new plan. As a result, they stayed with us.  atau  Our system stopped working. I found the cause and fixed it in two hours, so the team could continue.  atau  A project was late, so I made a new schedule and the team finished on time.

practice.q: What are your salary expectations?
answers: Based on my experience, I'm looking for a salary in the market range. Is that within your budget?
I'd like to discuss the range for this role.
I'm flexible, but I expect a salary that matches my experience.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Based on my experience, I'm looking for a salary in the market range. Is that within your budget?  atau  I'd like to discuss the range for this role.  atau  I'm flexible, but I expect a salary that matches my experience.

practice.q: When can you start?
practice.scene: Pewawancara menanyakan kapan kamu bisa mulai.
answers: I can start in two weeks.
I need to give two weeks' notice, so I can start in two weeks.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I can start in two weeks.  atau  I need to give two weeks' notice, so I can start in two weeks.  atau  I'm available in two weeks.

practice.q: That's all from us. Thank you for coming.
turns: That's all from us. Thank you for coming.
practice.id: Ucapkan terima kasih dan harap kabar.
answers: Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.
Thank you for the opportunity. I look forward to your reply.
Thank you very much. I hope to hear from you soon.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.  atau  Thank you for the opportunity. I look forward to your reply.  atau  Thank you very much. I hope to hear from you soon.

options: Situation
Skill
Solution
Success
Result
Reason
Reply

I had to solve the problem within two days.
The client was happy and thanked the team after that.

quiz.exp: Tugasmu. Jawaban yang tepat: **I had to solve the problem within two days.**

quiz.q: Pilih jawaban yang aman untuk pertanyaan gaji:
options: I am looking for a range that matches my experience.
I want the highest salary.
Nothing.
Please guess.
quiz.exp: Profesional. Jawaban yang tepat: **I am looking for a range that matches my experience.**

quiz.q: Pilih penutup email terima kasih yang baik:
options: Best regards, Budi
Bye bye, Budi
Hey, Budi
Whatever, Budi
quiz.exp: Profesional. Jawaban yang tepat: **Best regards, Budi**.

options: I can start in two weeks.
Maybe.
I do not know.
Never.
quiz.exp: Jelas. Jawaban yang tepat: **I can start in two weeks.**

quiz.q: Kapan sebaiknya mengirim email terima kasih?
options: pada hari yang sama atau esoknya
sebulan kemudian setelah wawancara selesai
sebelum wawancara dimulai di kantor
tidak perlu mengirim email sama sekali
quiz.exp: Cepat. Jawaban yang tepat: **pada hari yang sama atau esoknya**.

quiz.q: Hal yang sebaiknya dihindari saat wawancara:
options: menjelekkan perusahaan lama
memberi contoh nyata dari pengalaman kerjamu
bertanya hal profesional kepada pewawancara
mengucapkan terima kasih di akhir wawancara
